definitionZh: :root CSS伪类匹配代表文档的树根元素. 在HTML中,:root代表html元素,与选择器html完全相同,只是其特性(0-1-0)高于html的(0-0-1).
sourceDefinition: The :root CSS pseudo-class matches the root element of a tree representing the document. In HTML, :root represents the html element and is identical to the selector html, except that its specificity (0-1-0) is higher than html's (0-0-1).
